questions.question: God told Moses to place twelve tribe leaders' staffs in the Tent of Meeting. What would happen to the staff of the man God chose?

answers.text: It will turn into a snake

questions.question: After Moses left twelve staffs in the Tent of the Testimony overnight, what did he find on Aaron's staff?
God had Moses put Aaron's staff back in front of the Testimony to be kept as a sign for whom?
After Aaron's staff budded and Moses brought out the staffs, what did the Israelites declare to Moses?

answers.text: That they were all lost and perishing
That they would gladly follow Aaron
That they wanted to go back to Egypt
